'''2001 Massachusetts State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Massachusetts in 2001. [[Hayes Hunter]] won it.<ref name="dt-15364">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15364 Hayes' Hidden Mains], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 17 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15364/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15364/ GitHub Pages].</ref><ref name="dt-15588">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15588 Ten Numb Superstar], DeckTech (Mike "Deck" Gemme, 26 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15588/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15588/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2001 (before 17 April)
* '''Site:''' Massachusetts
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

Gemme, posting with his playtest partner Steebo, played a version of [[Alex Klammrodt]]'s Quiet Mining Colony deck. It lost only to [[Hayes Hunter]]'s deck, played by Steebo Baroni, and to a Dark sacrifice deck.<ref name="dt-15588" /> Hunter posted both decks as card for card what he won Massachusetts States with: a Dark My Kind Of Scum deck with Abyssins and Light Hidden Base mains.<ref name="dt-15364" /><ref name="dt-15366" /> Jon Bragg's Dark My Kind Of Scum deck went 1–2 (+4) there; he wrote that one loss was his own mistake.<ref name="dt-15329" /> Desai finished 3rd with a Light Watch Your Step deck; his only loss was to Hayes Hunter's Abyssin deck.<ref name="dt-15554" /> For the previous year's event see [[2000 Massachusetts State Championship]].
